raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Enterprise AI Engineer with 8+ years across NLP, Health Care, Media, OTT Platforms, semantic search, and production-grade GenAI systems. 3+ years building enterprise Gen AI & RAG platforms, multi-agent AI workflows, and LLM-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, FastAPI, and vector databases, MCP servers, fine- tuned domain models and HIPAA-compliant pipelines. Experienced in architecting scalable AI orchestration pipelines, enterprise compliance automation systems, and AI-driven content generation workflows.
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
AI Tech Lead · Cyient Apr 2026 – Present · Hyderabad, India.
  Mentoring AI engineers on prompt engineering, vector search systems, and scalable AI deployment practices.
Architecting enterprise AI Agent workflows and scalable orchestration systems leveraging LangGraph and RAG design patterns. Leading technical discussions around AI workflow integration, backend architecture, and reusable AI platform capabilities.
Deputy Manager – AI · Reliance JIO Aug 2022 – Apr 2026 · Hyderabad, India 
Architected enterprise RAG-based Semantic Search platform using E5 embeddings, FAISS indexing and cross-encoder reranking serving 50M+ JIO users with 40% reduction in search latency. Led a team of 4 engineers to build multi-agent JIO Email Automation Platform for JIO Fiber, Internet and Set-Top Box — classifying customer complaints across 10+ categories using LangChain, LangGraph and AutoGen processing 50,000+ support emails/month. Built RAG pipeline fetching resolution documents from vector database, auto-drafting personalized response emails via GPT-4.1 to reduce resolution time from 1 day to 2 hours cutting manual triage effort by 75%. Led delivery of JIO AI-Powered Hyperlocal Ad Generation Platform with 4 specialized agents — scanning competitors within 5km radius via Maps API and MCP servers, generating newspaper and fence ad creatives via Google Gemini Nano and 16-second promotional videos via Google Veo 3.1 across 500+ business campaigns.



Designed JIO Multilingual Voice Assistant Bot supporting 5+ Indian languages integrating Deep Learning STT, LLM chatbot using Llama V2
and LangChain and GlowTTS pipeline achieving 89% intent recognition accuracy.
Designed scalable FastAPI microservices for semantic retrieval and automated validation workflows supporting large-scale document
corpus across JIO Email and Search platforms.
Associate AI Engineer · Legato Health Technologies (Carelon Global Solutions) Sep 2020 – Aug 2022 · Hyderabad, India 
Built Intelligent AppBot Review System NLP pipeline performing sentiment analysis on user app comments, auto-detecting bugs via context-aware models, and auto-raising and assigning IT tickets reduced manual app review effort by 60% and cut average ticket assignment time across enterprise healthcare clients. Engineered Healthcare Document Template Analysis platform using YOLO V5 and TensorFlow Object Detection (TFOD) on AWS SageMaker processed 1000+ healthcare PDFs, annotated training data via LabelImg, trained and benchmarked models achieving mAP of 80% integrated into enterprise Cognitive platform ML pipeline supporting different document types.

Delivered Intelligent Meeting Transcription Tool full pipeline processing Webex recordings through Google Speaker Diarization and NVIDIA Jasper Seq2Seq STT implemented SyncNet (MTCNN) for speaker face + lip detection and Hough line transformation for PPT/DOCX screen content extraction auto-generating meeting minutes with 80% transcription accuracy all pipelines built in compliance with HIPAA standards for PHI/PII data handling. Built transformer-based summarization pipeline and React UI (login, upload, dashboard) for Transcription and AppBot tools deployed across 2 healthcare enterprise clients processing 250+ meeting recordings/month.

Data Scientist – Computer Vision · NVIDIA Graphics India Pvt Ltd Sep 2017 – Dec 2019 · Hyderabad, India

Applied Computer Vision for Object Detection and Path Detection pipelines supporting NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicle (AV) systems worked across multiple AV modules including road object detection and lane/path detection.
Generated and curated training datasets for AV models performed data mining and feature extraction to support model development
and improvement cycles.
Developed and maintained Quality Assurance procedure documentation for dataset validation workflows monitored dataset quality and
provided structured feedback to improve labelling accuracy.
